name: Anatomically-informed multi-LAP
summary: Segments white matter bundles in a target tractogram by anatomically-informed multiple Linear Assignment Problems (multi-LAP-anat), learning from WMC segmentations of example subjects, and outputs a WMC.
description: Supervised example-based bundle segmentation: example bundles from several subjects (AFQ or WMA WMC segmentations with their tractograms and T1s) are optionally aligned to the target with streamline linear registration (SLR), and for each requested bundle the target streamlines are selected by solving linear assignment problems that combine streamline distance, endpoint distance and ROI terms. Use it to transfer bundle definitions from example subjects to a new subject. Several bundles can be segmented in one run; WMA minor tracts (IDs 38-45) need the target FreeSurfer input. All example inputs must be given in the same subject order.

inputs.requirements: Same subject as the static T1.

inputs.description: Segmentations of moving (examples) subjects (they should be extracted from the tractogram provided)
inputs.requirements: One per example subject, in the same order as the moving tractograms and T1s.

inputs.description: FreeSurfer parcellation of static (target) subject (not used in version 1.0, needed for tractID from 38 to 45)

parameters.description: value for k-NN to compute the superset
If false, assuming subjects already co-registered in the same space
weight for the endpoint-based distance matrix
weight for the ROI-based distance matrix
ID list of the bundles of interest, separated by commas (refer to the README.md for the mapping)
parameters.placeholder: allowed values: 1-20 (if AFQ examples provided), 38-45 (if WMA examples provided)

citations.text: Bertò G., Avesani P., Pestilli F., Bullock D., Caron B., Olivetti E. Anatomically-Informed Multiple Linear Assignment Problems for White Matter Bundle Segmentation. ISBI 2019.
Avesani P. et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).

failure_modes.message: Inputs subject id incorrectly inserted. Check them again.
failure_modes.fix: Give the example segmentations, tractograms and T1s in the same subject order, and the static T1 of the same subject as the static tractogram.
Check the log for the Python error.
